name: Platform Password Reset
description: Client recovers access from /platform/login → 'Olvidé mi contraseña': requests a reset code (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/request/), enters the 6-digit code (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/verify-code/) and sets a new password (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/confirm/), then returns to login. Public platform pages: forgot-password, verify-code, reset-password.
